config.breadth_universe: Common dates of ES and all four breadth closes, matching earlier source universe; both selected breadth series require valid OHLC

skew_normalized_calendar.history: previous104calendar weeks all present; current excluded; sample standard deviation

skew_normalized_reported.history: previous104reported observations; current excluded; sample standard deviation

config.entry: Next ES daily open after completed breadth day; for SKEW first ES daily open in next Monday-Sunday week
config.nonoverlap: Chronological earliest qualifying complete window then require next entry at least h source sessions later, separately for each condition
config.matching: For each event use other full ES windows with same entry calendar year and weekday. Exclude any window sharing a held session with this event, then greedily retain earliest nonoverlapping reference windows; need >=1. Each event gets equal weight, each of its references equal weight; their h days equal weight. References may include signal weeks. Retrospective reference, not trading forecast.
config.daily_decomposition: Aggregate positive/negative/zero day weights; conditional positive and negative averages use their own signed-day weights; daily mean = positive_fraction*mean_positive + negative_fraction*mean_negative
config.path_cohort: Require complete h-session outcome first; same cohort at every plotted/reported session
config.COT: Excluded: supplied release timestamps explicitly nominal/unverified; actual historical release availability unresolved. No COT result claimed.
config.inference: No confidence intervals, significance, future probability or independent validation claim
config.costs: No executable strategy; chart changes before fees/slippage; do not treat daily observations as actual trades
